title: Learning Pseudo-Riemannian Manifolds for Heterophilic Graphs via Graph Signature
abstract: arXiv:2611.06265v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Several widely used families of Graph Neural Networks carry a positive-definite geometric prior. Graph convolution read as heat diffusion needs a positive semi-definite operator, hyperbolic models place features on positive-definite Riemannian manifolds, and dot-product and GAT-style attention scores use positive-definite inner products. On heterophilic graphs, where edges often signify dissimilarity or structural repulsion, that prior is a mismatch: no positive-definite form can assign a negative squared distance to a direction the labels separate. To measure the mismatch, we introduce the Graph Signature Index ($s_{\mathcal{G}}$), the inertia of a class-compatibility matrix built from label topology alone, and we prove that no value of the edge or node homophily index in $(0,1)$ rules out a negative eigenvalue. translated_title: 基于图符号的异质图伪黎曼流形学习
translated_abstract: arXiv:2611.06265v1 公告类型：cross（交叉发布）。摘要：若干广泛使用的图神经网络家族都带有正定几何先验。当图卷积被解读为热扩散时需要半正定算子，双曲模型将特征放置在正定黎曼流形上，而点积和GAT风格的注意力分数则使用正定内积。然而在异质图（heterophilic graphs）上，边往往表示不相似性或结构上的排斥，这种先验便产生了错配：任何正定形式都无法为标签所区分的方向赋予负的平方距离。为了度量这种错配，我们引入了图符号指数，它是仅由标签拓扑构建的类相容矩阵的惯性，并证明了在(0,1)区间内，任何边同质指数或节点同质指数的取值都无法排除负特征值的存在。随后，我们提出了伪黎曼注意力网络（PRAT），其注意力对数是一个带符号的平方伪距离……（摘要在此处不完整）
tldr: 该论文提出图符号指数（s_G）来量化正定几何先验与异质图之间的根本错配，并据此提出伪黎曼注意力网络（PRAT），通过带符号的平方伪距离注意力机制在伪黎曼流形上学习异质图表示。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces the Graph Signature Index (s_G) to quantify the fundamental mismatch between positive-definite geometric priors and heterophilic graphs, and proposes the Pseudo-Riemannian Attention Network (PRAT) that learns heterophilic graph representations through signed squared pseudo-distance attention on pseudo-Riemannian manifolds.
